d:
Dive into the romantic world of Happy Ending with this soulful track sung by Arijit Singh & Priya Saraiya. Composed by Sachin-Jigar with heartfelt lyrics by Priya Saraiya, this song beautifully expresses love, longing, and the tender moments that stay in your heart forever.
Let the soothing vocals and melodious music transport you to the magic of love.
Song: Jaise Mera Tu
Movie: Happy Ending
Singers: Arijit Singh & Priya Saraiya
Music: Sachin-Jigar
Lyrics: Priya Saraiya
Mixed and Mastered by Eric Pillai @ FSOB Studios
